query:
-- This query is derived from TPC-H query 7
-- THE TPC SOFTWARE IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT CHARGE FROM TPC.

select
        supp_nation,
        cust_nation,
        l_year,
        sum(volume) as revenue
from
        (
                select
                        n1.n_name as supp_nation,
                        n2.n_name as cust_nation,
                        extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,
                        l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume
                from
                        supplier,
                        lineitem,
                        orders,
                        customer,
                        nation n1,
                        nation n2
                where
                        s_suppkey = l_suppkey
                        and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
                        and c_custkey = o_custkey
                        and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
                        and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
                        and (
                                (n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' and n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')
                                or (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' and n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
                        )
                        and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
        ) as shipping
group by
        supp_nation,
        cust_nation,
        l_year
order by
        supp_nation,
        cust_nation,
        l_year

source.filter: ((("n_name" = CAST('FRANCE' AS char(25))) OR ("n_name_1" = CAST('FRANCE' AS char(25)))) AND (("n_name_1" = CAST('GERMANY' AS char(25))) OR ("n_name" = CAST('GERMANY' AS char(25)))))

root.predicate: (("l_shipdate" BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') AND system."$resolved"."@system@builtin@$internal$dynamic_filter_function@"("l_orderkey", 'EQUAL', 'df_1249', false))
("n_name" IN (CAST('FRANCE' AS char(25)), CAST('GERMANY' AS char(25))))
("n_name_1" IN (CAST('GERMANY' AS char(25)), CAST('FRANCE' AS char(25))))
